metadata.case_name: CHANG CHIN TSAI v. SHUM KIN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Computed tomography x-ray scan revealed a small area of high density on the left parietal lobe, an indication of a contusive injury.
source: Computed tomography x-ray scan revealed a small area of high density on the left parietal lobe, an indication of a contusive injury.

injuries.description: 4-cm long laceration on the left forehead; abrasions on the right forehead, cheeks, right hand and both knees; tenderness on the left chest.
injuries.body_part: forehead, face, right hand, knees, chest
source: including a 4-cm long laceration on the left forehead; abrasions on the right forehead, cheeks, right hand and both knees; and tenderness on the left chest.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

source: X-ray check also revealed a fracture of the left 5th rib although there was no sign of pneumothroax.

injuries.description: Wedge (compression) fracture of the lumbar spine at L-1 with loss between 25% and 50% of the vertical height of L-1.
source: X-ray examination showed a wedge fracture of the lumbar spine at L-1, but this had healed up.
the wedge fracture at L-1 of the lumbar spine had caused a loss between 25% and 50% of the vertical height of L-1.

injuries.description: Neck pain with tenderness on the lower cervical spine and a reduced range of movement of the neck (soft tissue / muscle pull injury to cervical region).
source: The report states that the Plaintiff complained of neck pain, tenderness on the lower cervical spine, and a reduced range of movement of the neck.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

manifestations.description: unsatisfactory coordination of the hands in performing minute movements
intermittent neck pain with varying degrees of painfulness
low back pain which exacerbated with movements
inability to work for more than 10 minutes
need for a walking stick to assist in walking
pain in the left chest when sleeping on the left side

treatments_received: suturing the laceration wound on his left forehead
treatment at the Intensive Care Unit
provision of a collar as part of the standard post-traumatic treatment
treatments_future: use of a Philadelphia neck collar (suggested)

losses.description: Impairment of intelligence and memory recorded by Dr Tsoi.
Impairment of vision recorded by Dr Tsoi.
Inability to speak clearly recorded by Dr Tsoi.
Unable to walk long distances and difficulty climbing staircases as a result of residual back pain.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulties in performing household chores (such as sweeping the floor, moving furniture and tidying up rooms) and making purchases at the market because of inability to carry heavy loads for an extended period of time.
Recommendation that the Plaintiff employ a part-time domestic helper to assist with strenuous chores.
